feeds.title: The Genau Group Blog
feeds.description: Genau Group clients are entitled to more than just 'brokerage.' We want every client, large and small, to receive a dynamic and diverse team of experts who provide a full set of skills. Our goal is to make the experience easy and stress-free. We want our clients to enjoy the process and arrive at the end feeling excited about their new space, confident about their decision, and optimistic about their future. We also strive to develop a sincere, long-term relationship with each and every client that lasts not just for one transaction cycle, but for as long as our clients remain in business.

feeds.title: Abbott Klar Real Estate Group Blog
feeds.description: For over 20 years, the Abbott Klar Real Estate Group has helped clients buy and sell homes throughout the Washington DC Metro area. With expertly crafted marketing plans. With trusted agents who know the ins and outs of the region. And with an unwavering commitment to helping everyone realize their dreams of home. Think of us as more than just realtors.

feeds.title: TTR Sothbey's International Realty Blog
feeds.description: The DC Real Estate Team is a group of like-minded real estate professionals at TTR Sotheby's International Realty that share a common goal of providing our clients with an information-rich, low-pressure experience in the buying or selling of DC area real estate.

feeds.title: Nomadic Real Estate Blog
feeds.description: Nomadic Real Estate provides leasing, property management, and sales services to individual owners or investors of residential property in Washington D.C., Northern Virginia, and parts of Maryland. Founded in 2005 by brothers Benjamin and Joseph Rieling, we remain family-owned and operated today. Read the blogs and find all the latest updates and information related to property management in Washington DC. Browse the vast selection of information related to investment properties.

feeds.title: DC Real Estate Mama
feeds.description: Living in DC is not just about politics. I'm a Realtor and work all over the DC, MD, and Northern VA area every day. My blog posts are all about life in DC, the pros& cons, and what it's like to live here, buy a home here, send your kids to schools here and have fun here. Get to know the neighborhoods, the businesses, and some history too!

feeds.title: Daryl Judy Real Estate Blog
feeds.description: Prior to real estate, Daryl thrived in education where he taught primary grades in public schools. This experience led him to believe that if you can successfully work with a classroom of 30 children, you can do anything.

feeds.title: WTOP » Real Estate
feeds.description: WTOP delivers the latest local news, traffic, and weather information to the Washington, D.C., region across multiple platforms. Read the blogs and stay informed of real estate trends, what's happening in the market, learn expert tips & much more with WTOP.

feeds.title: DC Condo Boutique Blog
feeds.description: Purchasing or selling a home or condo is often the largest and most important financial transaction of your life. In order to insure success, it is essential to find the best representation to assist in this process. The members of the DC Condo Boutique Team are experienced Realtors® with many years of both real estate and corporate experience. Our team is affiliated with TTR Sotheby's International Realty, a DC-based firm with a global luxury network, recognized for impeccable customer service and outstanding results.

feeds.title: At Home DC Blog
feeds.description: At Home DC is a Washington, DC-based business providing a range of residential real estate, decorating, and staging services to homeowners, future homeowners, and fellow real estate agents in DC, Maryland, and Virginia.

feeds.title: UrbanTurf DC
feeds.description: UrbanTurf is the leading online publication about DC-area real estate news and a daily must-read for people who want to remain in the know. Every month, 100,000 readers come to UrbanTurf to get the inside story on new development projects across the region. They come to learn about the patchwork of DC neighborhoods. To get the dirt about trends that influence how people buy, sell and rent. And to daydream about their next, great home.

feeds.title: Sherri Anne Green Blog
feeds.description: Sherri Anne is a certified luxury property specialist, certified pricing specialist, and certified relation specialist in DC and northern VA. She's sold all types of properties at all price points. Working with Sherri she will ma you out a custom strategic vision plan to sell your home quickly and for the best price possible.

feeds.title: 4J Real Estate Blog
feeds.description: 4J Real Estate is all about relationships. For us, selling and buying real estate is like opening a door and stepping through. Our 4JRE mission is to provide compassionate, attentive customer care to any and all real estate transactions from start to finish.

feeds.title: Eng Garcia Properties, LLC Blog
feeds.description: Eng Garcia Properties, LLC. has the tools that you need to succeed including insider knowledge of the marketplace, along with the negotiating skills to get the job done for you. We will make you our priority. We will be with you at the starting line, finish line, and beyond, to make sure that your Real Estate needs are not just met but exceeded.

feeds.title: DC Association of REALTORS Blog
feeds.description: The District of Columbia Association of REALTORS® (DCAR) is recognized by the National Association of REALTORS® as a state-level Association, and we represent more than 3,300 REALTORS® in DC. What that means is we advocate, protect and promote the interests of our members and the public we serve. We are the voice of real estate in the District, and we fight to ensure homeowner rights are preserved.

feeds.title: DCModernhomes.com Blog
feeds.description: The DCModernhomes.com Blog lists purchasable properties, market reports, trends, and more insights, for you to know. As a reputed local real estate player, The DC Modern Homes company uses both a holistic approach to representation as well as all available resources of modern technology to keep ahead of an ever-evolving real estate marketplace.

feeds.title: The Babbington Team Blog
feeds.description: For many people, buying or selling a home is not just a transaction; it is a major life step - one that can be challenging and confusing. That's why we built the Babbington Team: a diverse group of local realtors with unique skill sets. In the blogs, section read the latest real estate news, tips, trends, and insights for the Washington DC real estate market.

feeds.title: The DC Team Blog
feeds.description: The DC Team is proudly licensed in many other areas around DC, so if you're looking to move to another region, we can assist you with selling and finding a new home elsewhere. From Washington DC to Maryland and Virginia, our experts will satisfy all your luxury real estate needs.

feeds.title: Exposed Brick DC
feeds.description: Exposed Brick DC curates the Washington, DC real estate market to help you find your perfect rental, condo, or rowhome. Stop hunting, start shopping.

feeds.title: The Stokes Group Blog
feeds.description: The Stokes Group is passionate about real estate and we will go above and beyond at every opportunity. Our ability to anticipate your needs is a source of pride for us and we strive to have the answers before the question has even occurred to you and to create the best possible real estate experience for each and every client, every single time.

feeds.title: Washington Fine Properties News Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Washington Fine Properties, the premier residential real estate firm in the Nation's Capital. Our offerings of fine properties in all price ranges, coupled with the most seasoned real estate professionals in the DC, Maryland, and Northern Virginia markets, combine to offer our purchasers and sellers unparalleled real estate services. We have earned the privilege and reputation for listing and selling the finest properties our markets have to offer.
